1.1: Kol shehu yad velo shomer, mittamme umetamme velo mitztaref. shomer, af al pi sheeno yad, mittamme umetamme umitztaref. lo shomer velo yad, lo mittamme velo metamme:
1.2: Sharshe hashshum vehabbetzalim vehakkaflotot bizman shehen lachin, vehappitma shellahen ben lacha ben yevesha, vehaammud shehu mechuvvan keneged haochel, sharshe hachazarim vehatztzenon vehannafus, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, shoresh tzenon gadol mitztaref, vehassiv shello, eno mitztaref. sharshe hammitna vehappegam veyarkot sade veyarkot ginna sheakaran leshatlan, vehashshidra shel shibbolet vehallevush shellah, rabbi elazar omer, af hassig shel retzafot, hare ellu mittammein umetammeim umitztarfin:
1.3: Ellu mittammein umetammein velo mitztarfin. sharshe hashshum vehabbetzalim vehakkaflotot bizman shehem yeveshim, vehaammud sheeno mechuvvan keneged haochel, veyad happarkil tefach mikkan vetefach mikkan, yad haeshkol kol shehu, vezanav shel eshkol sherikkeno, veyad hammachbed shel temara arbaa tefachim, vekane shel shibbolet shelosha tefachim, veyad kol hanniktzarim shelosha, vesheen darkan likkatzer yedehem vesharshehem kol shehen, umalin shel shibbolin, hare ellu mittammeim umetammein velo mitztarfin:
1.4: Ellu lo mittammein velo metammein velo mitztarfin. sharshe kolse hakkeruv, vechulfot teradim, vehallefet, et sheddarkam liggazez veneekru. rabbi yose metamme vechullan umetaher besharshe kolse hakkeruv vehallafet:
1.5: Kol yedot hoochalin shebbesasan baggoren, tehorim. rabbi yose metamme. pesiga shel eshkol sherikkenah, tehora. shiyyer bah gargir echad, temea. sharvit shel temara sherikkeno, tahor. shiyyer bo temara achat, tame. vechen bakkitniyyot, sharvit sherikkeno, tahor. shiyyer bo gargir echad, tame. rabbi elazar ben azarya metaher beshel pol umetamme beshel kitniyyot, mippene shehu rotze bemishmushan:
1.6: Okatze teenim ugerogarot vehakkelusim vehecharuvim, hare ellu mittammein umetammein umitztarfin. rabbi yose omer, af oketz delaat. okatze haaggasin vehakkerustemelin vehapperishin vehauzradin, oketz delaat tefach, oketz kuneras tefach, rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer, tefachayim, hare ellu mittammein umetammein velo mitztarfim. ushear kol hookatzim, lo mittammein velo metammein:

2.1: Zetim shekkevashan betarfehen, tehorim, lefi shello chevashan ella lemare. keshut shel kishshut vehannetz shellah, tehora. rabbi yehuda omer, kol zeman shehi lifne hattaggar, temea:
2.2: Kol haggalinin mittammeot umetammeot velo mitztarfot. galina shel rotev, af al pi yotza, mitztarefet. shel yevesha, enah mitztarefet. lefichach, chotal shel yevesha, mitztaref. veshel rotev, eno mitztaref. galina shemmiktzatah yotza, shekkeneged haochel, mitztaref. etzem sheyyesh alav basar, shekkeneged haochel, mitztaref. haya alav mitztzad echad, rabbi yishmael omer, roin oto keillu hu makkifo vetabbaat. vachachamim omrim, shekkeneged haochel, mitztaref, kegon hassia vehaezov vehakkoranit:
2.3: Harimmon vehaavattiach shennimmok miktzato, eno mitztaref. shalem mikkan umikkan venimmok min haemtza, eno mitztaref. happitma shel rimmon, mitztarefet. vehannetz shello eno mitztaref. rabbi eliezer omer, af hammasrek tahor:
2.4: Kol hakkelippin mittammeot umetammeot umitztarfot. rabbi yehuda omer, shelosha kelippin babbatzal. happenimit, ben shelema ben kedura, mitztarefet. haemtzait, shelema mitztarefet, ukedura enah mitztarefet. vehachitzona, ben kach uven kach, tehora:
2.5: Hamechattech levashshel, af al pi shello merak, eno chibbur. lichbosh velishlok ulehanniach al hashshulchan, chibbur. hitchil lefarek, ochel shehitchil bo, eno chibbur. haegozim sheamanan, vehabbetzalim shechamaran, hare ellu chibbur. hitchil lefarek baegozim ulefakkel babbetzalim, eno chibbur. haegozim vehashshekedim, chibbur, ad sheyyerasses:
2.6: Betza megulgelet, ad sheyyagos. usheluka, ad sheyyerasses. etzem sheyyesh bo moach, chibbur, ad sheyyerasses. harimmon shepperado, chibbur ad sheyyakkish alav bekane. kayyotze vo, shelal hakkovsin vehabbeged shehu tafur bechilayim, chibbur, ad sheyyatchil lehattir:
2.7: Ale yerakot yerukkim, mitztarfin. ulevanim, enan mitztarfin. rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer, hallevanim mitztarfim bakkeruv, mippene shehen ochel. uvachazarim, mippene shehen meshammerin et haochel:
2.8: Ale vetzalim uvene vetzalim, im yesh bahen rir, mishtaarin bichmot shehen. im yesh bahen chalal, memaech et chalalan. pat sefoganit, mishtaeret bichmot shehi. im yesh bah chalal, memaech et chalalah. besar haegel shennitpach uvesar zekena shennitmaet, mishtaarin bichmot shehen:
2.9: Kishshut shennetaah beatzitz vehigdila veyatza chutz leatzitz, tehora. amar rabbi shimon, ma tivah littaher. ella hattame betumato, vehattahor yeachel:
2.10: Kele gelalim uchele adama, shehashsharashim yecholin latzet bahen, enam machshirim et hazzeraim. atzitz nakuv eno machshir et hazzeraim. vesheeno nakuv, machshir et hazzeraim. kamma hu shiuro shel nekev, kede sheyyetze vo shoresh katan. milahu afar ad sefato, hare hu chetavla sheen lah lizbez:

3.1: Yesh tzerichin hechsher veenan tzerichim machashava, machashava vehechsher, machashava velo hechsher, lo hechsher velo machashava. kol hoochalim hameyuchadim laadam tzerichin hechsher veenan tzerichim machashava:
3.2: Hachotech min haadam, umin habbehema, umin hachayya, umin haofot, minnivlat haof hattame, vehachelev bakkefarim, ushear kol yarkot sade chutz mishshemarkaim ufitriyyot. rabbi yehuda omer, chutz mikkereshe sade vehargila venetz hechalav. rabbi shimon omer, chutz min haakkaviyyot. rabbi yose omer, chutz min hakkelusin, hare ellu tzerichin machashava vehechsher:
3.3: Nivlat behema temea bechol makom venivlat haof hattahor bakkefarim, tzerichin machashava veenan tzerichin hechsher. nivlat behema tehora bechol makom, venivlat haof hattahor vehachelev bashshevakim, enan tzerichin machashava velo hechsher. rabbi shimon omer, af haggamal vehaarnevet vehashshafan vehachazir:
3.4: Hashshevet, mishshennatan tamo bakkedera, en bo mishshum teruma, veeno mittamme tumat ochalim. luleve zeradim veshel adal vaale halluf hashshote, enan mittammein tumat ochalim ad sheyyimtoku. rabbi shimon omer, af shel pakkuot kayyotze vahem:
3.5: Hakkosht, vehachemes, verashe vesamim, hattia, vehachiltit, vehappilpelin, vechallot charia, nilkachim bechesef maaser veenan mittammein tumat ochalin, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri, im nilkachim bechesef maaser, mippene ma enan mittammein tumat ochalin. veim enan mittammein tumat ochalim, af hem lo yillakchu vechesef maaser:
3.6: Happaggin vehabboser, rabbi akiva metamme tumat ochalin. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, mishsheyyavou leonat hammaasrot. peritze zetim vaanavim, bet shammay metammein uvet hillel metaharin. hakketzach, bet shammay metaharin, uvet hillel metammein. vechen lammaasrot:
3.7: Hakkor, hare hu cheetz lechol davar, ella shehu nilkach bechesef maaser. kafniyyot, ochalin, ufeturot min hammaasrot:
3.8: Dagim meematay mekabbelin tuma, bet shammay omrim, mishsheyyitztzodu. uvet hillel omrim, mishsheyyamutu. rabbi akiva omer, im yecholin lichyot. yichur shel teena shennifshach umeore vakkelippa, rabbi yehuda metaher. vachachamim omrim, im yachol lichyot. tevua shenneekra umeora afillu veshoresh katan, tehora:
3.9: Chelev behema tehora, eno mittamme tumat nevelot, lefichach hu tzarich hechsher. chelev behema temea, mittamme tumat nevelot, lefichach eno tzarich hechsher. dagim temeim vachagavim temeim, tzerichin machashava bakkefarim:
3.10: Kavveret devorim, rabbi eliezer omer, hare hi chekarka, vechotvin aleha perozbul, veenah mekabbelet tuma vimkomah, veharode mimmenna beshabbat chayyav chattat. vachachamim omrim, enah kekarka, veen kotvim aleha perozbul, umekabbelet tuma vimkomah, veharode mimmenna beshabbat patur:
3.11: Challot devash, meematay mittammeot mishshum mashke. bet shammay omrim, mishsheyyecharcher. bet hillel omrim, mishsheyyerassek:
3.12: Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehanechil lechol tzaddik vetzaddik shelosh meot vaasara olamot, shenneemar (Mishlei 8), lehanechil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle. amar rabbi shimon ben chalafta, lo matza hakkadosh baruch hu keli machazik beracha leyisrael ella hashshalom, shenneemar (tehillim 29), Adonai oz leammo yitten Adonai yevarech et ammo vashshalom:
